44th Detachment · UCN Marine Corp Personnel file

UCNMC Role Handbook

Every playable role in the 44th Sci-Fi ORBAT: where it sits, what it is for, and what it spawns with. Every slot spawns already wearing this kit, and the kit menu opens on spawn so you can swap to the options listed under each role.

29 playable slots17 kitsKit version 2026-10-01.4

Bulldog Platoon headquarters

Platoon Commander

Bulldog-1

Commands the detachment. Builds the plan with Zeus, assigns tasks to Zulu, Victor, Romeo and Mailman, and moves with Bulldog where they can see and talk to the whole fight. Holds the long-range net, so every squad leader reports here.
